sources.excerpt: STOMP BOX STEALS: FUZZ- CREBER INSTRUMENTS Classic Fuzz... very, very good BUT ? STOMP BOX STEALS Since 2015 NEW PEDALS EVERY DAY! Over 4500 REVIEWS! I use other reviewers vids & then critique from them __ If a pedal appears killer I buy one __ I try it out & update the Post__ If the pedal is SH@T I literally say so!__ I publish the street price a no brainer but few do. __ I save you time finding the best pedals & you get a second opinion. __OVER 4 MILLION VISTORS__ NO ONE OWNS ME___ I MAKE ZERO $ FROM THIS Paul L. Ewing / LENARD Re-Inventions View my complete profile Sunday, August 17, 2025 FUZZ- CREBER INSTRUMENTS Classic Fuzz... very, very good BUT ? $200.00 USD Creber     I N S T R U M E N T S  CASSICFUZZ The company refers to the pedal vaguely as 60's germanium Fuzz. It appears to be a Tone Bender MkII. The Layout is Volume, Gain and a BIAS control. C ONCLUSION ___  It sounds very good but it does not use the better NOS vintage parts that add more grit and a lot of character.  I recommend the $130.00 USD __TOL RED Germanium Fuzz which not only has the vintage parts but is built into an all steel sloped top period correct casing.   Check out the review Posted June 12/25. Ewing / LENARD Re-Inventions I have spent years in the music biz as a guitarist. I played in London England with the Prog rock band Tallis. I have always been curious in what makes an electric guitar, amp or pedal great. I was fortunate enough to make contacts with builders worldwide. I even had friends... old timers from the Gibson Kalamazoo factory. I learnt my craft from those that invented the electric guitars that we still love today. My design sensibility says "If it is not broke don't fix it!!!" I also feel the guitar is a tool! It is not a wall hanger display. Keep it simple! Keep to what works! As for pedals. I have many friends that are popular YouTubers as well as Independent pedal builders that give me a heads up about new things even before the release date. This way you can find it here first. sources.title: Classic Fuzz
sources.excerpt: Classic Fuzz - CIRCUIT FEATURES BRIGHT & AGGRESSIVE BC108 SILICON             TRANSISTORS, APPARENTLY FAVOURED  BY HENDRIX. - CIRCUIT BIAS (VOLTAGE ADJUSTMENT) CONTROL — DIAL IN YOUR             PREFERRED  FLAVOUR OF FUZZ. - EXTRA HIGH OUTPUT VOLUME FOR PUSHING  VALVE AMPS &             SUBSEQUENT EFFECTS. - MAINTAINED LOWS & EXAGGERATED HIGHS TO             ‘CUT THROUGH THE MIX’. - POPLESS TRUE BYPASS SWITCHING. - SUPER LOW- NOISE CIRCUIT DESIGN. - VINTAGE STYLE AMBER LED INDICATOR. - 1/4" / 6.35MM INPUT & OUTPUT JACK SOCKETS. - INPUT IMPEDANCE (APPROX): 1M - OUTPUT IMPEDANCE (APPROX): ≤3K - POWERED BY STANDARD 9V DC (NEGATIVE CENTER). - CURRENT DRAW (APPROX): <3 M A - REVERSE POLARITY CIRCUIT PROTECTION & POWER FILTERING. - STANDARD 2.1MM POWER SOCKET FOR REGULAR PEDAL POWER             SUPPLIES &  DAISY- CHAINS. (BATTERY IS DISCONNECTED             WHEN POWER JACK IS  INSERTED). - BATTERY CLIP OPTION INSIDE             (POWER  SAVING WHEN INPUT JACK IS ABSENT). - SATIN VINTAGE- STYLE ACRYLIC FINISH. - ROBUST & COMPACT DIE- CAST ALUMINIUM CHASSIS. - FULLY SHIELDED UNIT TO ELIMINATE INTERFERENCE AND NOISE. - COMPATIBLE BEFORE AND AFTER MOST OTHER EFFECTS UNITS -             BUT LET YOUR EARS DECIDE! - HAND WIRED & FINELY CALIBRATED FOR STUDIO- QUALITY TONE. THE ‘CLASSIC FUZZ’ IS A WILD BUT VERSATILE DEVICE WHICH HAS THE POTENTIAL TO REPLICATE THE FUZZY MADNESS WE’VE ALL ENJOYED SINCE THE 1960 s . BRIGHTER AND MORE INTENSE THAN A STANDARD OVERDRIVE OR DISTORTION PEDAL, THE UNPREDICTABLE NATURE OF THIS CIRCUIT IS WHAT MAKES IT SO ARTISTIC AND UNIQUE; THIS DEVICE IS CAPABLE OF PRODUCING THE MOST SATURATED AND HARMONICALLY RICH TONES YOU CAN IMAGINE. THE ‘BIAS’ CONTROL ADJUSTS THE VOLTAGE DELIVERED TO THE CIRCUIT WHICH CAN BE UTILISED TO SHAPE THE CHARACTER OF THE FUZZ, BROADENING THE RANGE OF COLOURS AND TONES THE UNIT CAN PRODUCE. BE SURE TO TRY THIS PEDAL IN VARIOUS POSITIONS WITHIN YOUR PEDAL CHAIN, TO ESTABLISH WHICH ARRANGEMENT GIVES THE BEST RESULTS. WE RECOMMEND PLACING IT AFTER COMPRESSORS AND BOOSTS.
